exactButtonMenuSequence: Open College Football 27 main interface and navigate to Road to Glory.
On Road to Glory Setup, choose Advance.
Select the observed journey type card highlighted before the position screen.
Choose QB on the position screen.
Open or observe Player Info from the Player tab.
Open Appearance from the Player tab.
Observe Head & Skin in the Appearance submenu.
